title: Value of Bob's truncated input at the special coordinate
statement: Fix a sample $\omega$ of the hard distribution, and write $T$ for its special coordinate. Let $y_{\ge T}$ be Bob's truncated input vector, whose value at a coordinate $i$ is Bob's bit at $i$ when $T \le i$ and is $\mathrm{false}$ otherwise. Then evaluating this vector at the special coordinate itself gives Bob's bit at the special coordinate: $y_{\ge T}(T)$ equals $y_T$.
hypotheses_covered: a sample ω of the hard distribution (on n ≥ 1 coordinates)
replaced: The $Y_{≥T}$ component of Alice's corrected conditioning contains the bit $Y_{T}$.
